title: An History of Birmingham (1783)
author: William Hutton

authorInfo.bio: William Hutton (1723–1815) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "An History of Birmingham" by William Hutton is a historical account written in the late 18th century. This work aims to document the history, character, and development of Birmingham, an important industrial city in England.
